Where Scheduling & dispatch goes wrong for HVAC

Seasonality breaks HVAC schedules — a cold snap fills the diary in a morning and maintenance visits get pushed out. Dispatching the nearest qualified technician is what keeps the day profitable.

What HVAC jobs really involve

Frequently asked questions

Which scheduling & dispatch tools work best for HVAC?

The three that fit best here are Housecall Pro (Home service businesses that want one app covering booking through to payment), Jobber (Owner-operators and small crews moving off paper and spreadsheets), ServiceTitan (Established businesses with multiple crews and a dedicated office team). Start with the one whose description matches your crew size, not the one with the longest feature list.

How much does scheduling & dispatch software cost for HVAC?

Across the 5 tools on this page, 1 have a free tier and the rest are paid, most of them billed per user per month. Prices change often, so treat the figures here as indicative and confirm on the vendor site.

Why does scheduling & dispatch cause problems for HVAC specifically?

Seasonality breaks HVAC schedules — a cold snap fills the diary in a morning and maintenance visits get pushed out. Dispatching the nearest qualified technician is what keeps the day profitable.

Should maintenance contracts be billed monthly or annually?

Monthly billing is standard because it smooths seasonality and keeps the customer on the books. Annual billing is simpler to administer but leaves you without contact between visits.
